newsitem.title: USA: ITT Industries unit buys rest of venture.
newsitem.headline: ITT Industries unit buys rest of venture.

text.p: ITT Automotive, a unit of ITT Industries Inc, said it acquired the remaining 20 percent equity that General Motors Corp had retained in an automotive systems and components venture managed and operated by ITT Automotive Electrical Systems Inc since 1994.

The ITT Automotive Electrical Systems Inc venture was formed in April 1994 when ITT Automotive acquired an 80 percent interest in the motors and actuators business unit of the Delco Chassis Division of GM Automotive Components Group Worldwide ESI.

This business, together with other electrical systems operations, provides wiper, air, seat, door and window management systems, motors and power accessory hardware for nearly every major automotive producer in the world.
